TWO MICROSECONDS — how to run this game on macOS
=================================================

This game is a tiny indie build. It is "ad-hoc" signed (no Apple
Developer ID) and not notarized, so macOS Gatekeeper will block it
the first time and may claim it is "damaged". It is not damaged —
macOS just doesn't know us. Pick ONE of the options below.


EASIEST — Terminal (works on every macOS version)
-------------------------------------------------
1. Drag "Two Microseconds.app" out of this disk image to wherever
   you like (e.g. ~/Applications or your Desktop).
2. Open Terminal and run (adjust the path to where you put it):

     xattr -cr ~/Applications/"Two Microseconds.app"
     open ~/Applications/"Two Microseconds.app"

   `xattr -cr` removes the com.apple.quarantine attribute that your
   browser attached when the file was downloaded. That attribute is
   the only thing standing between you and 2.2 microseconds of fun.


macOS 15 (Sequoia) and newer — no Terminal
------------------------------------------
Apple removed the old right-click trick in macOS 15, so:
1. Double-click the app. It will be blocked — that's expected.
2. Open  System Settings > Privacy & Security,  scroll down to the
   Security section. You'll see a note that the app was blocked.
3. Click "Open Anyway", then confirm in the dialog that appears.


macOS 14 (Sonoma) and older — no Terminal
-----------------------------------------
Right-click (or Control-click) the app > Open > Open.
You only need to do this once.


LAST RESORT — run the raw binary from the command line
------------------------------------------------------
The executable inside the app bundle can be launched directly:

     "/path/to/Two Microseconds.app/Contents/MacOS/Two Microseconds"

(Tab-completion is your friend. Quotes matter — there's a space.)


CHECKING STATUS
---------------
To see what Gatekeeper thinks of the app:

     spctl --assess -vv "/path/to/Two Microseconds.app"

"rejected" is normal for an ad-hoc signed app; it will still run
fine once the quarantine attribute has been cleared as above.


HOW TO PLAY
-----------
You are a muon. You were just born 100 km above a particle detector
and you have 2.2 microseconds to live. Luckily, the faster you move,
the slower your clock ticks (this is real physics — special
relativity's time dilation). Reach the detector before you decay,
and cause some optional mischief on the way down.

  WASD / arrows / left stick ... move
  SPACE (or SHIFT / gamepad A) . zip (dash)
  Z / X / click (gamepad X) .... zap (your honk)
  TAB .......................... to-do list
  ESC .......................... pause
  F / M ........................ fullscreen / mute

Move fast. Fast muons age slowly.
